amountWhole: Amount must be a whole number
amountMax: Amount exceeds the maximum allowed value
amountMin: Amount must be at least 1 cent
rateMax: Interest rate exceeds the allowed maximum
termInteger: Term count must be an integer
termMin: Term count must be at least 1
termMax: Term count exceeds the allowed maximum
firstPaymentAfterStart: First payment date must be after the start date
installmentRequired: Enter the installment amount and use French amortization (no custom installments) to derive the number of installments
interestOnlyLessThanTerm: Interest-only installments must be less than the term count
installmentCoversInterest: The installment must cover interest and amortize the principal within the allowed maximum
customTotalsRequired: A value for every installment is required for Custom amortization
amountRequired: The amount is required for this adjustment
customInstallmentRequired: Enter the installment number and amount
principalExceedsBalance: The amount exceeds the available balance of the selected account
installmentExceedsTotal: The installment cannot be greater than the total payable with interest
